MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_TRANSMIGRATION.desc:
[color=#CC6666] [Death Recall] [/color]’s gift, [color=#CC6666] [Death Recall] [/color]’s curse
When you play a card with [color=#CC6666] [Reincarnation] [/color], the same card with the same name as [color=#CC6666] [Reincarnation] [/color] in your draw pile is automatically played (up to 2 cards)
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_TRANSMIGRATION3.des: When you play a card with [color=#CC6666]【 reincarnations and reincarnations】 [/color], play cards with [color=#CC6666]【 reincarnations and reincarnations】 [/color] from anywhere, up to three cards each time
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.title: Agree
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.description:
If the number is a multiple of 1 to 5, the effect will be triggered.
×1: All allies gain 3 shield points
×2: Gain 3 shield points for yourself
×3: All allies gain 1 layer of temporary agility
×4: All allies gain 2 layers of temporary power
×5: A random card in your hand can be played once for free, and all friends will gain 1 point of energy.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.title: doubt
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.description:
If the number is a multiple of 1 to 5, the effect will be triggered.
×1: Gain 1 shield for yourself
×2: Draw 1 card yourself
×3: Gain 1 point of energy
×4: Recycle 1 card from the discard pile
×5: 1 hand card added to replay 1, 1 hand card to get 1 [color=#339966] [[/color][color=#cc9966] Judgment [/color][color=#6699cc] [/color][color=#339966]] [/color] Enchantment
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.title: refute
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.descriptio:
If the number is a multiple of 1 to 5, the effect will be triggered.
×1: Randomly causes 1 point of damage
×2: Gain 1 point of strength
×3: All enemies gain 1 layer of vulnerability
×4: Randomly cause an equal number of 1 points of damage
×5: This card is played 1 extra time
